nightly-eval-bot: Nightly eval finished for branch 'main' / model 'rw-infer-3b'. Alert: quantized profile 'int8+fp8-mix' shows a 9.8% drop on summarization prompt set (rouge-1). Failing prompt sample attached.

mira: ugh, saw this in the dashboard. spike started 02:00GMT. Rolling window diff points to quant profile change we shipped yesterday. :thinking_face:

sam: can someone paste the eval command & seed so i can reproduce locally?
jordan: repro steps from CI: `./bin/run_eval --model rw-infer-3b --quant-profile mix-int8-fp8-v3 --suite summarization --seed 42 --batch 1`

mira: i ran that locally w/ CPU offload and saw identical bad outputs for prompt id 8217. Short hallucination at the end, token deletion in the middle.

sam: paste the two generations (fp32 vs quant) for that prompt?
nightly-eval-bot: fp32 output: "The report shows a steady increase in revenue over Q3, with marketing costs stable."
nightly-eval-bot: quant output: "Revenue dropped in Q3. marketing costs rose sharply."

jordan: that's a polarity flip, not just noise. Could be scale failure in attention or softmax underflow from quant params.

mira: i looked at the activation histograms during calibration — the layer 10 attention logits have a long tail after the new profiling. variance increased ~3x.

ops-ryan: any infra/driver changes around the same time? we pushed a small kernel reorder to the fused-attn path yesterday afternoon.
sam: good catch. that change touched int8 matmul reorder for sequences > 512. but our summarization prompts are short (~120). still could affect kv cache or quant rescaling.

mira: quick experiment idea: re-run nightly with old kernel build + new quant profile. if regression goes away, kernel is suspect. if stays, profile.
jordan: also try running quant with per-channel rescale vs per-tensor to see sensitivity. I can spin up a GPU node and run 3 configs in parallel.

sam: commands: ```
# baseline (old kernel, new profile)
GIT_HASH=prev-kernel ./bin/run_eval --model rw-infer-3b --quant-profile mix-int8-fp8-v3 --suite summarization --seed 42
# kernel new, profile old
GIT_HASH=new-kernel ./bin/run_eval --model rw-infer-3b --quant-profile mix-int8-fp8-v2 --suite summarization --seed 42
# new kernel + new profile
GIT_HASH=new-kernel ./bin/run_eval --model rw-infer-3b --quant-profile mix-int8-fp8-v3 --suite summarization --seed 42
```

ops-ryan: running the three now on gpunode-07, ETA ~18m. ping me if you want logs streamed.
mira: i'll also re-run calibration with a tighter percentile (99.999 -> 99.995) and see if the tail shrinks. if quant scales are being clipped, that could flip sign in logits.
sam: flag to record: add a targeted noisy seed to stress tail activations for calibration (we should add to nightly).
jordan: FYI i toggled per-channel rescale on one run — preliminary results show rouge1 drop halved (from 9.8% -> ~5%). not perfect but points to rescale strategy being a big factor.

mira: OK next steps: 1) wait for ops-ryan runs, 2) mira to rerun calibration with adjusted percentile, 3) jordan to run per-channel sweep and collect top-10 prompt diffs, 4) sam file an issue linking kernel change and quant profile PRs.

ops-ryan: gpunode-07 finished: new-kernel + new-profile reproduced the failure (rouge1 -9.6). old-kernel + new-profile looks closer to fp32 (rouge1 -1.2). attaching logs: /mnt/logs/2056789012-run.tar.gz

mira: that implicates the kernel change. i'll roll back the kernel reorder on a canary and re-run a subset overnight.
sam: great, i'll prep a rollback PR and include a test that runs summarization suite under mix-int8-fp8 profiles.
jordan: also let's add a small fuzz harness that injects high-logit tails during calibration to catch future regressions.

mira: thanks all. i'll update the incident ticket with findings and tag infra + runtime leads. :thumbsup:

nightly-eval-bot: Incident updated: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2034 — status: triage in progress.
